questions.q: Change to Passive: 'They are playing cricket.'
options: Cricket is being played by them.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous active ('are playing') -> 'is being played' in passive.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change to Passive: 'I have clean my room.' (I have cleaned my room)
options: My room has been cleaned by me.
My room was cleaned by me.
My room is cleaned by me.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect active -> 'has been cleaned' in passive.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change to Indirect: He said, 'Honesty is the best policy.'
options: He asked if honesty is best policy.
He told honesty is best policy.
He said that honesty was the best policy.
He said that honesty is the best policy.
questions.explanation: Proverbs retain Simple Present Tense in Indirect Speech.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change to Indirect: She said to him, 'Please help me.'
options: She asked him for help her.
She requested him to help her.
She told him to help her.
questions.explanation: Imperative sentence with 'Please' -> 'requested + object + to + V1'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Fill in correct verb: Look! The sun _____.
questions.explanation: Exclamatory command 'Look!' indicates an action happening now (Present Continuous).
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Fill in correct verb: She _____ a new car last week.
questions.explanation: Definite past time marker 'last week' requires Simple Past ('bought').
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Fill in correct article: He is _____ European.
questions.explanation: 'European' begins with a consonant sound 'yu', so 'a' is used.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Fill in correct article: I saw _____ one-eyed man.
questions.explanation: 'One-eyed' begins with a consonant sound 'w' (wan), so 'a' is used.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Fill in correct modal: You _____ obey the traffic rules.
questions.explanation: Compulsion and strict legal rule require 'must'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Fill in correct modal: _____ I come in, sir?
questions.explanation: Formal polite permission requires 'May'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He is ashamed _____ his conduct.
questions.explanation: The adjective 'ashamed' takes the preposition 'of'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: Put out the lamp; turn _____ the light.
questions.explanation: 'turn off' means to switch off an electrical light.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He was born _____ a poor family.
questions.explanation: He was born in a family.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: The property was divided _____ four brothers.
questions.explanation: More than two recipients take 'among'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He aims _____ winning the prize.
questions.explanation: The verb 'aims' takes 'at'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Subject-Verb Agreement: Neither the principal nor the teachers _____ present.
questions.explanation: Verb agrees with nearest plural subject 'the teachers' -> 'were'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Subject-Verb Agreement: Either you or he _____ to go.
questions.explanation: Verb agrees with nearest singular subject 'he' -> 'has'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Subject-Verb Agreement: The news _____ true.
questions.explanation: Uncountable singular noun 'news' takes singular verb 'is'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Subject-Verb Agreement: Mathematics _____ an interesting subject.
questions.explanation: Names of subjects ending in 's' take singular verb 'is'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Subject-Verb Agreement: The cost of all these items _____ risen.
questions.explanation: Main subject is 'The cost' (singular), so verb is 'has'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the Synonym of 'Poverty'?

questions.q: What is the Synonym of 'Conceal'?

questions.q: What is the antonym of 'Generous'?

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He passed the exam _____ hard work.

questions.q: Translate: 'मेरे स्टेशन पहुँचने से पहले गाड़ी खुल चुकी थी।'
